description: Get one durable debt instrument by its Equibles identifier. Returns current balances, linked filing observation, verified covenant bullets, exact source quotes, and governing or amending SEC documents. History, covenants, and documents are independently paged. Use GetDebtProfile first to obtain the instrument identifier.

evidenceOffset.description: Zero-based character offset into the exact evidence for these history and covenant pages.

instrumentId.description: Debt instrument identifier returned by GetDebtProfile.

maxCovenants.description: Maximum covenant rows to return (default 10, max 10).

maxDocuments.description: Maximum governing/update documents to return (default 10, max 10).

maxEvidenceCharacters.description: Maximum exact-evidence characters to return for these history and covenant pages (default 0, max 12000). Use a positive value to read evidence losslessly in character pages.

maxHistory.description: Maximum filing-history rows to return (default 10, max 10).

name: GetDebtInstrument
title: Debt Instrument Detail
